what: The small news panel slides endlessly one line at a time with embla (4s dwell), and among the 3px bars below the panel, divided by line count, the current line’s bar fills from the left with no curve over the 4s dwell — when it moves on, the other bars are emptied. If dragged by hand, the bar also moves to that line and fills from the start.

options.delay: Dwell (sec), default 4 — the bar fills over the same length
options.duration: embla slide duration (physics units, not ms), default 25
options.[data-fx-part=bars]: Bar slot (if present, adds as many bars as there are lines)

use: News line…

from.where: index.js .fv-news — original .news_carousel: embla { loop } + Autoplay() default 4000ms, on each select fillBar 4000ms linear forwards on .progressbar .bar.active .fill (width 0→100%), bars 3px·1px gap between
